name: Magellan Corporation
note: US private distributor of specialty steels, headquartered in Deerfield, Illinois; the Fire's Official Jersey Sleeve Sponsor since 2024. Its website names the leadership (founder and President Bob Arthur, since its inception in 1985) but does not state who owns the company, and no public filing or press report naming an owner was found, so no ownership claim could be written and the sponsor stays not rated yet.
